name: parallax-scroll
title: Parallax Scroll Grid
blurb: Three-column image grid with parallax scroll offset per column.
description: A 3-column grid where each column scrolls at different speeds via motion/react useTransform. Images are distributed evenly across columns and animate vertically based on scroll position.
use_when: Image galleries, portfolio showcases, or content sections needing visual depth via parallax scrolling.
avoid_when: Mobile or touch-heavy experiences; parallax effects may feel jarring on small viewports or cause motion sickness.
a11y: Images have semantic alt attribute support; scroll-driven animations may be disorienting without prefers-reduced-motion handling.
